item.title: Dangerous or intimidating animals problem, 30th July
item.description:
Hello, this morning I took my dog for an early morning walk up to Cleeve common. We came across a group of seven young cows on the path grazing off to the side, then looking directly at us. I picked up my small silent dog to walk past them, upon which they grouped together across the path. Whilst they appeared more curious than aggressive, they did then follow us up the path. I went back down to get the attached photo. It is somewhat difficult to use a right of way when there are large animals which could become dangerous for walkers. Also, there were no signs saying that there would be cattle in the area. It would be useful to know what is considered reasonable or legal in this situation, but it was very disappointing Eliza Clark
Report on FixMyStreet
